name: diamond press
description: A narrow push-up variation with the hands close together, putting extra load on the triceps and inner chest.
instructions: Start in a plank position with your hands under your chest, thumbs and index fingers forming a diamond.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward your hands, elbows tracking back close to your ribs.
Pause briefly just above your hands.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight so your hips do not sag.
